notes: Prototype combat adaptation (designer spec, Oct 2026), not Captain's Log rules. Captain's Log personal conflict (pp.203-206) has no range bands, weapon Severity, or Stun/Deadly modes.
A successful attack causes exactly 1 Hit. Severity is not damage; it is recorded on the final Hit for later injury systems.
Weapons link to carried equipment by itemId (items.json for phasers). The Unarmed Strike is always available.
beamColor: presentation only (the shot effect on the battlefield). Weapons without one show a strike flash instead of a beam.
maximumRange: designer decision - pistols stop at Long; only rifles reach Extreme. Each band beyond optimalRange adds +1 Difficulty.

ranged.note: Designer decision (Oct 2026): base 1, changed from the spec's 2 because 2d20 can never pass Difficulty 3+. Matches the book's Difficulty 1 baseline (p.205).

melee.note: Not in the designer spec. Daring + Security follows the book's melee example (p.204); Difficulty matches ranged until decided.

weapons.name: Phaser Rifle
weapons.note: Severity and qualities undefined in the spec. Nobody carries one in the first encounter.

weapons.name: Disruptor Pistol
weapons.note: Designer-approved placeholder. Book p.33: disruptors have no stun setting.

weapons.name: Unarmed Strike
weapons.note: Not in the designer spec; added because characters fight with carried equipment only. Injury mode and Severity are placeholders.
